choose.when: SELECT CMP_MSG_ID AS msgid, CASE WHEN USED_CD IN ('00', '10', '20') THEN 'PH' WHEN USED_CD = '30' THEN 'AT' WHEN USED_CD = '40' THEN 'G1' END AS messagetype, CASE WHEN USED_CD = '00' THEN 'S' WHEN USED_CD = '10' THEN 'L' WHEN USED_CD = '20' THEN 'M' END AS smskind, SND_MSG AS msgsms, CASE WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '82%' THEN RCV_PHN_ID WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '010%' THEN CONCAT('82', SUBSTRING(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15)) ELSE CONCAT('82', SUBSTRING(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15)) END AS phn, SND_PHN_ID AS smssender, RESERVED_DTTM AS reservedt, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regdt, TMPL_CD AS tmplid, SENDER_KEY AS profile, KISA_CODE AS kisacode, MSG_TITLE AS title, ATT_IMAGE AS attimage, ATT_BUTTON AS attbutton, ATT_ITEM AS attitem, ATT_COUPON AS attcoupon, CAR_HEAD AS carhead, CAR_LIST AS carlist, CAR_TAIL AS cartail FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SMS_STATUS = '0'

SELECT CMP_MSG_ID AS msgid, CASE WHEN USED_CD IN ('00', '10', '20') THEN 'PH' WHEN USED_CD = '30' THEN 'AT' WHEN USED_CD = '40' THEN 'G1' END AS messagetype, CASE WHEN USED_CD = '00' THEN 'S' WHEN USED_CD = '10' THEN 'L' WHEN USED_CD = '20' THEN 'M' END AS smskind, SND_MSG AS msgsms, CASE WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '82%' THEN RCV_PHN_ID WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '010%' THEN '82' + SUBSTRING(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15) ELSE '82' + SUBSTRING(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15) END AS phn, SND_PHN_ID AS smssender, RESERVED_DTTM AS reservedt, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS regdt, TMPL_CD AS tmplid, SENDER_KEY AS profile, KISA_CODE AS kisacode, MSG_TITLE AS title, ATT_IMAGE AS attimage, ATT_BUTTON AS attbutton, ATT_ITEM AS attitem, ATT_COUPON AS attcoupon, CAR_HEAD AS carhead, CAR_LIST AS carlist, CAR_TAIL AS cartail FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SMS_STATUS = '0'
choose.otherwise: SELECT CMP_MSG_ID AS msgid, CASE WHEN USED_CD IN ('00', '10', '20') THEN 'PH' WHEN USED_CD = '30' THEN 'AT' WHEN USED_CD = '40' THEN 'G1' END AS messagetype, CASE WHEN USED_CD = '00' THEN 'S' WHEN USED_CD = '10' THEN 'L' WHEN USED_CD = '20' THEN 'M' END AS smskind, SND_MSG AS msgsms, CASE WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '82%' THEN RCV_PHN_ID WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15) END AS phn, SND_PHN_ID AS smssender, RESERVED_DTTM AS reservedt, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regdt, TMPL_CD AS tmplid, SENDER_KEY AS profile, KISA_CODE AS kisacode, MSG_TITLE AS title, ATT_IMAGE AS attimage, ATT_BUTTON AS attbutton, ATT_ITEM AS attitem, ATT_COUPON AS attcoupon, CAR_HEAD AS carhead, CAR_LIST AS carlist, CAR_TAIL AS cartail FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SMS_STATUS = '0'
